description: Key Responsibilities Gather, analyse, and document business and technical requirements in collaboration with business stakeholders. description: Shift Pattern: Standard 40 Hour Week (United Kingdom) Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 Corporate Grade: D - Assistant Vice President Reporting Line: (UK Division) Information Technology Location: UK-London Worker Type: Permanent Overall Purpose of Role The Product Owner is responsible for defining, prioritising, and delivering product capabilities that meet business and operational needs. Working closely with stakeholders, technology teams, service owners, and delivery teams, the Product Owner ensures that product investments are aligned to organisational priorities and deliver measurable business value. The Product Owner acts as the voice of the customer and business, translating requirements into clear product outcomes, maintaining the product roadmap and backlog, and ensuring delivery teams remain focused on the highest-priority work. They are accountable for guiding products through their lifecycle, from concept and requirements definition through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Ownership Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, priorities, and desired business outcomes. Collaborate with business stakeholders, service owners, and technology teams to understand requirements, challenges, and opportunities. Own and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring work aligns with strategic objectives and delivers maximum value. Define and refine epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success measures. Translate business requirements and operational needs into clear and actionable product deliverables. Make informed prioritisation decisions, balancing business value, risk, technical constraints, and delivery considerations. Monitor product performance, adoption, and customer feedback to inform future priorities and improvements. Manage the product lifecycle from initial concept through delivery, adoption, enhancement, and retirement. Act as the primary advocate for customer and business needs throughout the delivery lifecycle. Delivery & Execution Lead the successful delivery of product initiatives, ensuring agreed outcomes are delivered within approved scope, timescales, and governance requirements. Coordinate activities across business, technology, operational teams, and third-party suppliers where required. Manage dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, and change impacts affecting product delivery. Support Agile delivery practices including backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritisation, acceptance testing, and release planning. Define release scope and acceptance criteria to ensure delivered capabilities meet business requirements. Balance competing priorities and delivery constraints to maximise value and delivery confidence. Ensure delivered solutions are operationally ready, supported, and successfully adopted by users. Monitor delivery progress and product outcomes, taking corrective action where required. Provide regular updates on delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and achievement of expected outcomes. Promote continuous improvement in product delivery, user experience, and operational effectiveness. Stakeholder & Governance Management Build and maintain effective relationships with business, technology, operational, and delivery stakeholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for product-related requirements, priorities, and decisions. Facilitate discussions and decision-making between stakeholder groups to maintain alignment and delivery focus. Ensure product activities comply with established governance, risk, and control processes. Provide timely and accurate reporting on roadmap progress, delivery status, risks, dependencies, and outcomes. Present recommendations, priorities, and delivery updates to stakeholders and governance forums. Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure effective communication throughout the delivery lifecycle. Support change management and adoption activities to maximise business value from delivered capabilities. Foster collaboration across teams to achieve shared objectives and successful delivery outcomes. Financial & Commercial Management Contribute to business cases, funding requests, and investment planning activities where required. Support budget planning and expenditure tracking for product initiatives. Assist in evaluating delivery options and prioritisation decisions based on value, cost, risk, and business objectives. Work with Finance, Procurement, Technology, and business stakeholders to support effective investment decisions. Collaborate with third-party suppliers and delivery partners to ensure agreed outcomes are achieved. Support procurement, contract management, renewals, and supplier reviews where appropriate. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and maximise value from product investments. Support financial and governance reporting requirements throughout the product lifecycle. description: de Savary International | Dubai, UAE Full-time | Hybrid About de Savary de Savary is a contemporary luxury fashion brand specialising in statement leather, suede and outerwear. With an international e-commerce presence, dedicated UK/global and Middle East online stores we are an ambitious, founder-led brand with a strong creative identity and an international customer base. We are looking for an experienced, commercially minded Marketing & E-commerce Manager to help drive the next stage of our growth. The Opportunity This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines creative marketing instincts with strong commercial awareness and hands-on e-commerce experience. Working closely with the founder, you will take ownership of our marketing activity, e-commerce operations and customer growth strategy. We are looking for someone who can develop ideas, execute independently, analyse performance and identify opportunities to increase revenue. This is not simply a marketing coordination role. We want someone who can make a measurable impact on the business. Key Responsibilities Marketing Strategy & Growth Develop and execute marketing strategies to drive revenue, customer acquisition and retention. Plan and manage seasonal campaigns, collection launches and promotional activity. Identify opportunities to grow our international customer base. Manage the marketing calendar, budgets and campaign performance. Coordinate paid advertising agencies, ensuring activity aligns with commercial objectives. Analyse customer behaviour, acquisition costs, conversion and return on marketing investment. Develop strategies to improve customer loyalty and repeat purchases. Identify and execute new growth opportunities across digital channels. E-commerce & Shopify Manage the day-to-day commercial operation of our UK/global and Middle East Shopify storefronts. Upload and merchandise products, collections, imagery, variants and pricing. Coordinate product launches, pre-orders, waitlists and website updates. Optimise product pages, website navigation and customer journeys. Monitor website traffic, conversion rates and sales performance. Manage promotional activity, discount codes and merchandising updates. Oversee routine international market settings, working with relevant specialists on shipping, tax and checkout requirements. Troubleshoot routine Shopify issues and coordinate developers or technical specialists when required. Produce regular e-commerce trading reports and identify opportunities to improve performance. Email Marketing & CRM Own our Klaviyo email marketing strategy. Plan, create and execute newsletters and automated campaigns. Develop customer segmentation and retention strategies. Optimise automated flows, including welcome, abandoned checkout and post-purchase communications. Analyse email performance and revenue contribution. Identify opportunities to improve customer lifetime value. Brand, Partnerships & Campaigns Oversee influencer marketing, gifting and affiliate activity. Develop strategic brand partnerships and collaborations. Coordinate PR activity and external agencies. Work closely with our social media and founder content team to align content with commercial campaigns. Support events, launches and brand activations. Ensure consistency in brand positioning and messaging across customer touchpoints. About You We are looking for someone who is: Commercially driven, with a strong understanding of how marketing translates into revenue. Experienced in managing Shopify and confident making website updates independently. Proficient in Klaviyo or a comparable email marketing platform. Analytical, with the ability to interpret performance data and turn insights into action. Creative, proactive and comfortable developing new marketing ideas. Highly organised and capable of managing multiple priorities. Confident working directly with a founder in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment. Comfortable taking ownership and executing without constant supervision. Previous experience in fashion, luxury, beauty, lifestyle or consumer e-commerce is advantageous, but not essential. We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate measurable commercial results in previous roles. What We Offer The opportunity to play a key role in the growth of an international fashion brand. Direct collaboration with the founder. Significant ownership of marketing and e-commerce strategy. A creative, entrepreneurial working environment. The opportunity to develop and execute your own ideas. Hybrid working in Dubai. Competitive salary, dependent on experience, with performance-related bonus potential. How to Apply Please submit your CV along with a brief introduction outlining your relevant experience. We would particularly like to hear about: Marketing campaigns you have managed and their measurable results. Your Shopify and e-commerce experience. Your experience using Klaviyo or similar CRM platforms. Examples of how you have contributed to revenue growth.
title: Marketing & E-commerce Manager

description: Job Introduction Handelsbanken combines a long-established relationship banking model with secure, resilient, and customer-focused technology. Our technology teams enable the Bank’s decentralised way of working, delivering systems built for stability, trust, and long-term value. We are on a multi-year technology and digital transformation journey to enhance customer experience and improve how colleagues work together. By modernising platforms, simplifying processes, and better connecting data and systems, we help relationship teams focus on customers and less on complexity. Our decentralised culture extends to technology. Teams are trusted to take ownership, make informed decisions, and deliver sustainable, high-quality solutions. We value engineering excellence, pragmatic problem-solving, and strong collaboration across technology, business, and risk. We offer technologists the opportunity to build lasting careers, deepen their expertise, and contribute to meaningful change. We look for people who care about quality, security, long-term impact, and who want to shape the future of a relationship-led bank. Check our Handelsbanken website for further information The opportunity At Handelsbanken UK, we are about to embark on an a programme of rationalisation and modernisation of our payments technologies. This includes the replacement of our legacy platform with a brand new payments engine. We are looking for a highly proficient Business Analyst to work specifically within our payments area and alongside Product Owners, as part of a multi-disciplinary, Agile, payments modernisation team. This Business Analyst will have experience in a banking environment and be familiar with payments technologies, channels, processes, and payment types, including CHAPS, BACS, SEPA, Faster payments, International SWIFT, ISO20022, Cheques and Cash. Key responsibilities Elicit requirements - Working with 3rd party vendors, business and technical teams to elicit requirements through a variety of means, including running Discovery workshops. Analysis, detailed requirements definition, prioritisation and traceability - Breaking down epics, containing high level requirements, into detailed requirements and features that will be mapped into designs. Helping to maintain a product backlog and supporting prioritisation efforts and sprint planning. Tracing approved requirements to detailed designs and test scenarios, through User Stories, Prototypes and Design / UX. Stakeholder management -ensuring optimal ways of working and that clear accountabilities are in place. Sharing output and managing stakeholder relationships where business analysis interaction is involved across technology, the business, at management level and 3rd party vendors. Process mapping - Documenting As Is and To Be process flows to map the payments processes and handoffs between teams – including happy paths and exception flows of Inbound and Outbound payments, Returns and Rejects Supporting testing teams - Supporting Acceptance and Regression testing for areas including audit logging, accounting, reports, notifications and downstream BAU Supporting the operational model - Supporting the production of materials, including writing instructions, training and colleague comms, and in the production of IT Ops runbook processes Engagement with Change Delivery teams - Working with teams including architecture, testing and release management and in accordance with the Bank’s change management methodology, to ensure that all necessary documents and artefacts are in place, toll-gates are adhered to and evidences are captured Risk Management -Operating in line with the Bank's Risk Management frameworks and relevant risk and compliance policies and procedures, ensuring that appropriate and timely escalation of any concerns are made Governance - being at the heart of ensuring that governance and guidelines are applied. This includes applying Business Analysis standards and those of the Bank, to developing and nurturing standards through the quarterly BA Community of Practice What we’re looking for Research (by Harvard University) shows that women are particularly likely to second guess themselves and not apply - so if you are worried you don't meet all the criteria, get in touch anyhow and let us do the worrying… Industry knowledge - Be an experienced Business Analyst, possessing experience in working on payments projects within a banking environment. You will be familiar with payments technologies, channels, processes, and payment types; and you will have a good understanding of the latest payments industry regulations and standards. Agile methodology - Be adept at Agile ways of working and ceremonies and with an understanding of controls within the context of a regulated environment. Experience of working in close union with product owners and/or delivery managers to establish and maintain a product backlog, support prioritisation efforts and sprint planning, whilst collaborating with developers and quality assurance analysts. Able to 'T-shape' were necessary. Agile toolset - Have good knowledge of tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS SharePoint, MS Teams and virtual white boarding tools – and use these to produce quality output throughout the lifecycle of the project, including Feasibility and Business Case documentation, Requirements Definition, User Stories, Prototypes and Design / UX, and supporting Acceptance testing. Analyse and Refine - Have strong analytical, organising and problem solving skills, with a quality-focused attitude, high attention to detail. You will understand the overall business strategy and problem statements. You will be able to elicit and refine requirements and align the technology vision and solution requirements to strategic goals. Communication and Stakeholder Management - You will have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills and will have used these to produce clear output to a range of stakeholders across technology, the business and at management level. You will be experienced in managing stakeholder engagement and will have a proven reputation in building effective and positive relationships with project vendors and 3 rd parties. You will have experience of collaborating with, learning from, and teaching others as you work within a team producing sustainable systems Flexible approach – You will have the ability to adapt and flex your business analyst approach, to get the most out of your fellow team members and to provide an excellent service to stakeholders. Why join Handelsbanken We want everyone at Handelsbanken to feel supported, motivated, and able to do great work. That’s why, alongside brilliant colleagues, meaningful work and training and development opportunities, we provide a variety of benefits designed with your wellbeing in mind. In addition, there is a flexible benefits package with the key highlights detailed below. Application next steps Your journey with us begins once you have submitted your application. One of our Handelsbanken Talent Acquisition Partners will be reviewing your details and will later organise a phone conversation if your experience aligns with our requirements, we will extend an invitation for you to participate in an interview. This advert will be live for a minimum of one week. However, please note that after the one week, the closing date could change at any time depending on the number of responses received. The Bank is deeply committed to embedding good equality and diversity practice into all of our activities. This is so that we are an inclusive, welcoming and inspiring place to work that encourages everyone to apply, regardless of socio-economic background, age, disability, pregnancy and/or parental status, race (including colour, nationality, and ethnic or national origin), veteran status, marital and civil partnership status, religion or belief, sex, gender reassignment or sexual orientation.

description: Qui recrute ? Corps grand-ducal d’incendie et de secours La Direction de la Coordination Opérationnelle est chargée de la mise en œuvre nationale des moyens destinés à protéger et secourir les personnes ainsi qu’à sauvegarder les biens lors d’événements calamiteux. Elle assure la coordination des opérations de secours à travers notamment le CSU-112, centrale nationale de réception et de traitement des appels d’urgence, ainsi que l’exécution des stratégies opérationnelles sur le terrain. Elle joue également un rôle essentiel dans le recrutement et l’accompagnement des pompiers volontaires, au cœur du modèle de secours luxembourgeois. Missions La mission principale du titulaire du poste consiste à soutenir le Service des données opérationnelles dans l’analyse, la structuration, l’exploitation et la valorisation des données opérationnelles du CGDIS. Il contribue au développement des outils de Business Intelligence et de statistiques opérationnelles afin de fournir des informations fiables et pertinentes pour la prise de décision. Il conçoit le suivi des analyses, rapports, indicateurs et tableaux de bord liés aux activités opérationnelles du CGDIS et en assure le suivi. En complément de ses missions liées à la Business Intelligence et aux données, il soutient de manière générale la gestion de projets relevant du Service des données opérationnelles, avec un accent particulier sur les projets liés aux données, aux statistiques et aux outils de Business Intelligence. Faire parler les données: Analyser et structurer les données opérationnelles pour produire des statistiques fiables et pertinentes; Repérer les tendances, évolutions et anomalies qui aident à décider; Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer rapports, indicateurs et tableaux de bord. Garantir la confiance dans les chiffres: Veiller à la qualité, à la cohérence, à la traçabilité et à l’exploitabilité des données; Mettre en place des contrôles de validation automatisés pour détecter erreurs et incohérences; Documenter les définitions d’indicateurs, les méthodes de calcul et les standards. Travailler main dans la main avec le terrain: Recueillir et formaliser les besoins des utilisateurs en statistiques et en BI; Les accompagner dans l’utilisation et l’interprétation des rapports et analyses; Collaborer avec les différentes unités du CGDIS pour améliorer en continu processus, outils et méthodes. Piloter des projets: Coordonner et suivre les projets du service, en particulier ceux liés aux données, aux statistiques et à la BI; Participer à la modélisation et à la préparation des données pour les solutions de BI; Assurer l’évolution continue de nos outils. Profil Compétences techniques Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse, le traitement, la structuration et la visualisation de données; Vous comprenez le fonctionnement des bases de données et des modèles de données; Vous maîtrisez les étapes de préparation et de validation des données; Vous savez concevoir des analyses statistiques, des indicateurs et des tableaux de bord pertinents; Vous connaissez les outils de BI et de Data Visualisation; Vous savez cerner un besoin métier et le traduire en solution concrète; Vous avez de bonnes bases en gestion de projet (planification, coordination, suivi); Vous êtes sensible aux enjeux de protection des données, de cybersécurité et de confidentialité; Vous aimez documenter : un bon indicateur est un indicateur que tout le monde comprend. Compétences comportementales Comprendre l'organisation : Vous réfléchissez de façon systémique, au-delà des silos, vous connaissez les évolutions de l'environnement et déterminez les indicateurs critiques de performance; Gérer les projets : Vous initiez et coordonnez des projets transversaux selon un référentiel de gestion de projets et vous réalisez les projets dans les délais, budgets et le périmètre définis et selon le niveau de qualité exigé; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l’objectif commun; Servir le client-usager : Vous accompagnez le client-usager de manière personnalisée, vous entretenez des contacts réguliers et constructifs, vous appliquez les lignes de bonne conduite administrative; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l’innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d’autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez constructif face à la critique et vous agissez de façon constante malgré les difficultés; S'autodévelopper : Vous vous remettez en question de façon régulière, vous apprenez de vos erreurs et vous apprenez continuellement; S'impliquer : Vous vous engagez pour générer des résultats, vous assumez la responsabilité et la qualité des actions entreprises, vous vous engagez pour le bien commun. Atouts Des connaissances en algorithmes de prédiction (R, Python, etc.); Des connaissances en outils de Business Intelligence et de Data Visualisation; Des connaissances ou une expérience dans le domaine de la gestion de projets; Une bonne connaissance du fonctionnement interne du CGDIS; Une expérience de pompier, professionnel ou volontaire : un vrai avantage pour comprendre le terrain que vous allez analyser. Conditions d’admission Ce poste peut être pourvu sous le statut de fonctionnaire de l'État ou d'employé de l'État. Vous n'avez pas à choisir votre statut au moment de postuler : celui-ci est déterminé au terme du processus de recrutement, en fonction des conditions à remplir pour chaque statut. Le poste est également ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Niveau d’études Vous êtes titulaire d’un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d’enseignement supérieur reconnu par l’État du siège de l’établissement et sanctionnant l’accomplissement avec succès d’un bachelor en sciences informatiques appliquées ou sciences cognitives, avec un focus sur la « data », la « machine learning » et/ou l’intelligence artificielle ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 6 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Langues Vous devez remplir les conditions générales de connaissance des trois langues administratives. Ces conditions ne s'appliquent pas dans le cadre d'un changement d'administration. Nationalité Vous êtes ressortissant d’un État membre de l’Union européenne. Important Seules les candidatures introduites via la plateforme officielle GovJobs.lu seront prises en considération. Toute candidature transmise par un autre canal (e-mail, courrier, etc.) ne pourra pas être retenue.

description: At MySivi, we're building India's first AI Tutor that's transforming how people learn spoken English. Our AI provides instant feedback on grammar, pronunciation, and fluency, helping users improve faster than ever before. Today, we've already helped 2Cr+ users , and we're just getting started. Our goal? Scale MySivi to ₹500Cr+ ARR in the next 6-8 months. We're looking for someone who wants to build, experiment, fail fast, learn faster, and drive massive growth alongside the founders. We spend more than ₹20 lakhs per day on user acquisition. But growth isn't just about getting more installs, it's about converting those users into paying customers and building a profitable business. We're looking for a Growth Manager who will own the entire funnel, from acquisition to purchase. You'll work closely with performance marketing, product, engineering, and creative teams to identify growth opportunities and turn them into measurable business results. We've raised minimal funding, don't believe in burning money, and love to operate profitably. What will you do? 🚀 Own full-funnel growth: Take complete ownership of the user journey, from ad impressions and installs to activation, trial starts, purchases, and revenue. 📊 Find growth opportunities: Analyse funnel data, cohort behaviour, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and retention to identify the biggest bottlenecks and opportunities. 🎯 Drive acquisition: Work closely with performance marketers to scale Google and Meta campaigns, improve user acquisition efficiency, and attract high-quality users. Experiment on new channels. 🧪 Run growth experiments: Form hypotheses, prioritise experiments, and test new ideas across creatives, onboarding, user activation, trial conversion, paywalls, pricing, and offers. 📱 Improve product conversion: Work closely with product and engineering teams to ship experiments that improve activation, engagement, trial-to-purchase conversion, and revenue. 💰 Own growth economics: Improve purchase revenue and ROAS while balancing acquisition costs, conversion rates, average order value, and retention. 🤝 Break team silos: Bring marketing and product teams together around shared goals, clear metrics, and data-backed decisions. Take ownership of outcomes instead of passing problems between teams. ⚡ Build a growth engine: Establish a systematic process for tracking metrics, running experiments, documenting learnings, and scaling successful initiatives. You will be a great fit if you: ✔️ Have 3–7 years of experience in growth, growth marketing, product growth, or consumer internet businesses. ✔️ Have hands-on experience working across both paid acquisition and post-install conversion funnels. ✔️ Understand CAC, ROAS, LTV, retention, activation, trial-to-purchase conversion, and subscription economics. ✔️ Can independently analyse data, identify bottlenecks, form hypotheses, and turn insights into experiments. ✔️ Have worked closely with product and engineering teams to improve user journeys and conversion rates. ✔️ Take complete ownership of outcomes instead of waiting for instructions or blaming other teams. ✔️ Are comfortable getting your hands dirty: analysing data, building reports, setting up experiments, and following through until results are measured. ✔️ Thrive in a fast-moving startup where speed, execution, and measurable impact matter more than presentations. Bonus Points Experience scaling consumer mobile apps with subscription or in-app purchase models. Experience with Google UAC (App Campaigns), Meta Ads, and mobile attribution tools such as Adjust or AppsFlyer. Experience with WebEngage, Amplitude, GA4, or other analytics and lifecycle marketing tools. Experience improving onboarding, activation, paywalls, pricing, and trial-to-paid conversion. Strong analytical skills, including SQL or the ability to independently investigate large datasets. Experience building growth processes or working across marketing and product teams. Why join MySivi? Work directly with the founders on a high-impact business problem. Own a critical growth function with direct influence on revenue and profitability. Get the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and implement your ideas. Work with significant acquisition budgets and a team focused on measurable results. Help build a repeatable growth engine that can scale across multiple products.' This is not a traditional marketing role. We're looking for someone who can connect acquisition, product, and monetisation and take ownership of turning users into paying customers. Please apply only if you enjoy solving growth problems hands-on, working with data, and taking ownership of business outcomes. Feel free to send an email at hiring@mysivi.ai with the subject "Growth Manager at MySivi - NAME" if you think you would be an amazing fit. Do mention why you would be an amazing fit. This is the fastest way to get noticed :) We are fast and will complete the process within few days.

description: About Verto At Verto, we're on a mission to democratise global finance and empower businesses in Emerging Markets to reach the world. Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth. What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually. We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale. We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets. We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future. Join us as we continue to grow and transform global finance. Role Overview We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Growth and Marketing Manager to spearhead customer acquisition, engagement, and retention efforts across the UAE. In this pivotal role, you will build a strong local brand presence, launch high-impact campaigns, and drive measurable B2B growth. By identifying new market opportunities and leveraging your deep digital marketing expertise, you will play a central role in advancing Verto’s mission to become the leading cross-border payments partner in the region. description: Cobo builds secure financial rails for humans and AI agents. Founded in 2017 by blockchain pioneers, Cobo safeguards billions of dollars in assets for 500+ institutions worldwide with a zero-incident security track record, certified to ISO 27001 and SOC 2. Today, Cobo runs the industry’s most complete digital asset platform: multi-model custody spanning Custodial, MPC, Smart Contract, and Exchange wallets with broad multi-chain, multi-network, and multi-token support; stablecoin payment rails that move value at internet speed; and self-serve, AI-guided onboarding that brings enterprise-grade security to teams of any size — set up in minutes, not months. As AI agents become economic actors, Cobo is building the trust infrastructure they will transact on. Visit www.cobo.com for more information. Role Overview: We are looking for a full-stack Growth Marketer to own Cobo’s AI Demand Gen engine end to end - from strategy and execution to measurement and optimisation. This is an AI-native evolution of a traditional digital marketing role. Rather than owning a single channel, you will build and operate integrated growth campaigns across GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), SEO/SEM, paid media, source channels such as YouTube and LinkedIn, and the product-led growth funnel. You will work hands-on with Cobo’s existing custody, wallet, and payment products, while building the growth playbook that can scale our next generation of AI-powered products. Role Responsibilities: Own AI Demand Gen End to End — Act as the single accountable owner for AI Demand Gen, covering quarterly planning, channel strategy, budget allocation, execution, optimisation, and measurable results. This is a full-stack growth role, not a single-channel position. Own GEO / AI Search Visibility — Make Cobo a trusted and frequently cited source when buyers ask AI engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini about digital asset custody, wallets, and payments. Identify and manage GEO partners, develop the content and authority strategy, and work with the data team to measure AI-referred traffic and conversions. Drive SEO & SEM — Own technical SEO, content strategy, search visibility, and backlink growth. Plan and manage paid search campaigns with clear attribution, disciplined budget management, and continuous optimisation. Build Source Channels — Develop YouTube and LinkedIn as strategic channels for both organic discovery and AI-search visibility. Work with content and video freelancers to create, distribute, and optimise content that compounds over time. Own the PLG Growth Loop — Partner closely with Product to improve the sign-up and activation funnel through conversion analysis, A/B testing, CRO, and user journey optimisation. Turn growth insights into actionable product improvements and establish a regular feedback loop with Product. Build Attribution & Reporting — Rebuild and improve marketing-sourced pipeline measurement with the data team. Own growth dashboards, lifecycle and nurture flows, attribution, and lead-handoff SLAs to ensure marketing impact is clearly connected to revenue. Build AI-Native Marketing Operations — Use AI agents and automation to streamline research, content production, campaign operations, analytics, and reporting. Build repeatable AI workflows and playbooks, while orchestrating specialist freelancers and agencies to maximise output and speed. Role Requirements: Minimum 5 to 8 years of digital / growth marketing experience, with a proven track record of owning full-funnel campaigns from strategy and execution through to measurable business results. At least a Bachelor’s degree or above in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. Strong SEO fundamentals with hands-on GEO / AI-search experience, including familiarity with GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, or equivalent tools. Full-stack growth expertise across paid media, SEO/SEM, email/lifecycle marketing, CRO, analytics, and marketing attribution. Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Customer.io, or similar platforms is preferred. AI-native mindset - you actively use LLMs and AI agents to build real workflows and automate marketing operations, rather than simply using AI for content generation or prompting. Strong owner mentality - comfortable setting strategy, making trade-offs, executing hands-on, and being accountable for outcomes. Able to manage and direct specialist freelancers and agencies without relying on a large internal team. Experience in AI is strongly preferred; Web3 / digital assets is a plus.
